title: Sharon Lokedi Captures Seventh Abbott World Marathon Major Podium in Chicago
summary: With a second-place finish at the 2026 Chicago Marathon, Lokedi secured the seventh Abbott World Marathon Major podium of her career, crossing the finish line in 2:14:07 against one of the deepest and most competitive fields assembled this season. The result further cements her position among the world's elite marathoners and continues a remarkable run of success across the sport's biggest stages.
body_markdown:
The Chicago Marathon has long been recognized as one of the fastest and most competitive races in the world. Year after year, it attracts many of the sport's top athletes, producing memorable performances and some of the quickest marathon times in marathon history. Earning a place on the podium requires not only exceptional preparation, but also the confidence and composure to compete with the very best athletes in the sport.


For Lokedi, Chicago represents yet another example of her ability to perform across a variety of courses and competitive environments. New York rewards patience, tactical decision-making, and the ability to navigate one of the most energetic race atmospheres in the world. Boston demands strength, experience, and discipline across one of marathon running's most challenging courses. Chicago, meanwhile, is often defined by speed and a field packed with many of the world's fastest athletes.


Excelling in any one of those environments is difficult. Earning podium finishes across all three demonstrates a level of versatility and consistency reserved for the sport's elite.


Throughout that journey, Under Armour has remained a constant presence. Over nearly a decade with the brand, Lokedi has evolved from a promising young athlete into one of distance running's most respected competitors while helping shape the next generation of performance running footwear along the way.


For her podium performance in Chicago, Lokedi raced in an exclusive edition of the UA Velociti Elite 3, Under Armour's pinnacle racing silhouette developed in close collaboration with elite athletes. Designed to deliver lightweight efficiency, energy return, and confidence over 26.2 miles, the shoe represents years of athlete feedback and innovation aimed at helping runners perform at their highest level when the stakes are greatest.
